[Vulkan] Fix unaligned fill/update (#24838)

Unaligned fills/updates are implemented via kernels and thus require a
compute-able Vulkan queue.

Re-applies
https://github.com/iree-org/iree/commit/fef9d232aebc0d1e5d3d2839565dce5c3cd26282.

Fixes #24771
